name: Architekturzentrum Wien
notes: Single server-rendered page has both Ausstellungen and Termine lists, no pagination needed; program is published out to mid-Dec 2026 (~4 months) on this one page. price_min always null, site never states prices on the listing. The permanent exhibit 'Hot Questions - Cold Storage' has a fabricated far-future data-endDate (site sentinel); detected via the 'permanente Ausstellung' label in event-card_date and emitted with end=null, extra.permanent=true instead of passing the sentinel through.
